whl_maid_vol.text: She was built by A and J Inglis, the Glasgow shipbuilders, in sections, then bolted together at Balloch in 1953. She was the last paddle steamer built in Britain.
Paddle steamers are wonderfully simple. A steam engine turns a wheel and the wheel shoves the water. We are shoving at the council for a grant.

whl_maid_purser.text: Sailed her for years. Tea in the saloon, a band on summer Saturdays, and a purser's life is mostly telling people which way is the loch. It's the big wet thing.
